raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 16
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly claimed Wikipedia stated Waylon Jennings was buried in Chandler, Arizona at “Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery,” conflating death place with burial and contradicting the earlier confirmed Find a Grave entry showing City of Mesa Cemetery, Mesa, Arizona. This introduced a wrong specific burial location and created the core factual error.
